notes: All Ford material (Ford Heritage Vault brochures, fleet.ford.com archives) counts as ONE source; Wikipedia articles count as ONE. Excluded: 1955-56 Ford Fairlane Crown Victoria (a Fairlane trim, not this model line). 1980-82 rows are the LTD Crown Victoria trim of the full-size LTD; LTD/LTD S-only NHRA rows (e.g. 1982 351/165 on LTD S) are left out. GrandMarq.net "Box Panther Horsepower/Torque Figures" (club/forum site that Wikipedia cites) used as context only, not counted. KBB specs pages checked and rejected (inconsistent: 2004 220 hp, 2006 250 hp, 2007 220 hp). hp_sources = number of non-EPA sources that state the HP figure. The web-search budget ran out before a second reputable HP source could be found for the 1983-91 civilian ratings and 2008-11. Hemmings/MotorTrend/Car and Driver are blocked; Michigan State Police full reports (ncjrs.gov) returned errors. [v2 2026-10-14] Michigan State Police patrol-vehicle evaluations (ojp.gov/NCJRS scans; spec tables plus independent testing) used as an independent government source. MSP 1980 and 1982 reports cover LTD/LTD S police cars only (1980 LTD S 351W H.O. 172 @ 3400; 1982 LTD 351 H.O. 165 @ 3600) - context, not Crown Victoria rows. Archive.org Standard Catalog books are lending-restricted (no text access). No reputable source found for the 1984-86 police 351 H.O. rating, the 1984-85 '155 hp' engine, the 1980-81 302 ratings, or CNG horsepower beyond Ford's 1998 sheet.
